rules.label: SSN
rules.notes: Nine digits, or three-two-four with hyphens. 000, 666, and 900 to 999 are not area numbers. A phone shape is not a match. An unformatted number needs a nearby label.

rules.label: ITIN
rules.notes: Nine digits starting with 9. The fourth and fifth digits fall in an issued ITIN range. An unformatted number needs a nearby label.
